correctness.rationale: Read frozen RESULT.md and exact checker.py. For each distance 1<=j<R, the greedy kernel steps down with probability 3/4 and up with 1/4; at even antipode it deterministically steps down, at odd antipode it stays with 1/4. Solving h_j-(3/4)h_{j-1}-(1/4)h_{j+1}=1 with boundary gives h_j=2j+A_N(3^j-1), strictly increasing, establishing the Bellman optimality of closer offers for all adaptive controllers. The moment recurrence (I-P)s=2h-1 gives displayed Var formula with parity B_N. Independently solved rational linear systems for N=3..24 and all distances (143 pairs), matching exact means and variances. The characteristic transform has two geometric roots lambda(z),Lambda(z) and an exponentially suppressed boundary coefficient; analytic uniform log F_d(e^u)=d log lambda(e^u)+O(u), log lambda=2u+3u²+O(u³) yields CLT and uniform O(1) variance. Formula tested including small boundary N=3; no variance-optimal claim.
